root_cause: BitVecCore::clear drops elements before clearing occupancy bits and length; a Drop panic makes the outer Drop revisit occupied slots.
hidden_obligations: Normal clear removes every element, runs its destructor once, retains capacity, sets num_elements and next_push_index to zero, and permits reuse.

A panicking destructor must not leave an already-dropped value reachable or available to be dropped again. After catching a panic, occupancy and num_elements must agree; a particular rollback or retained-suffix layout is not required.
Sparse stable indices survive unrelated removals. Panic-path leakage is allowed but not required; ordinary operation must not leak.
allowed_changes: implementation under src/ preserving the public API
panic-drop guard and metadata commit order
non_goals: not a general proof of stable-vec soundness
not a claim about unrelated iterator code
construction_phase: after original/fixed feasibility controls, before any new model trajectory; fixed source was inspected
